0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_INACTIVE_TASK_ABORT
0.description: The assigned venture will be abandoned as it is no longer available.
0.translation_description: La spedizione assegnata verrà annullata perché non è più disponibile.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LVUP_NO_CLASS
1.description: Unable to use <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>. You must first assign a class for your retainer.
1.translation_description: Impossibile usare <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>. Devi prima assegnare una classe al tuo servitore.

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LVUP_NO_EFFECT
2.description: Unable to use <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>. Your retainer has already attained level <hex:022003E80303>.
2.translation_description: Impossibile usare <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>. Il tuo servitore ha già raggiunto il livello <hex:022003E80303>.

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LVUP_CAP_PLAYER
3.description: Your retainer cannot exceed your own level.
3.translation_description: Il tuo servitore non può superare il tuo livello.

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ASK_PLAYER_LVSYNC
4.description: You can only advance your retainer as far as level <hex:022003E80203>, to match your current level. Do you wish to proceed?
4.translation_description: Puoi portare il tuo servitore solo al livello <hex:022003E80203>, pari al tuo livello attuale. Vuoi procedere?

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LVUP_NO_ITEM
5.description: You do not have <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203> in your possession.

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_DEFAULT_TALK
8.description: You have not yet received approval to hire retainers.
8.translation_description: Non hai ancora ricevuto l'autorizzazione ad assumere servitori.

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_NO_RETAINERS_AVAILABLE
9.description: You have not yet hired a retainer.
9.translation_description: Non hai ancora assunto un servitore.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_CALL_RETAINER_FAILED
10.translation_description: Il tuo servitore non ha risposto.

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_DISABLE_RETAINER_BELL
11.description: The bell does not seem to be functioning...

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_CALL_FAILED_NO_CHARGE
12.description: You cannot summon that retainer unless you resume payment for their services.
12.translation_description: Non puoi evocare il servitore finché non riprendi a pagare per i suoi servizi.

13.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_RESET_ERROR_EQUIPMENT
13.description: You cannot change your retainer's class/job until all gear has been removed.
13.translation_description: Non puoi cambiare classe o job al tuo servitore finché non gli avrai tolto tutto l'equipaggiamento.

14.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_NO_CURRENT_TASK
14.description: Your retainer has not been assigned a venture.
14.translation_description: Non hai assegnato una spedizione al tuo servitore.

15.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_RECOMMEND_JOB_CHANGE
15.description: Your retainer is qualified to be trained in more advanced traditions. Select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Assign retainer a job<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to proceed.
15.translation_description: Il tuo servitore può imparare discipline più avanzate. Seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Assegna un job al servitore<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> per continuare.

16.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_SUGGEST_JOB_CHANGE
16.description: To train your retainer in a more advanced tradition, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Assign retainer a job<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to proceed.
16.translation_description: Per addestrare il tuo servitore in una disciplina più avanzata, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Assegna un job al servitore<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

17.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_SUGGEST_JOB_SCROLL
17.description: To assign your retainer a job, you must purchase <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203> from a retainer vocate and have it in your inventory.
17.translation_description: Per assegnare un job al tuo servitore, devi acquistare <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203> da un addetto ai Servitori e averlo nell'inventario.

18.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_JOB_ERROR_EQUIPMENT
18.description: You cannot assign your retainer the <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103> job until all gear has been removed.
18.translation_description: Non puoi assegnare al tuo servitore il job <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103> finché non gli avrai tolto tutto l'equipaggiamento.

19.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_JOB_ERROR_NEED_RETAINER_LEVEL
19.description: You cannot assign your retainer the <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103> job until they have achieved level <hex:022003E80303>.
19.translation_description: Non puoi assegnare al tuo servitore il job <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8020103> finché non avrà raggiunto il livello <hex:022003E80303>.

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_JOB_ERROR_NO_ITEM
22.description: Unable to proceed. You do not have <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203> in your possession.

24.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_JOB_CHANGE_FAILED
24.description: You cannot assign a job to a retainer who is currently undertaking a venture.
24.translation_description: Non puoi assegnare un job a un servitore impegnato in una spedizione.

25.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ASK_BE_CHANGE_JOB
25.description: Your retainer has attained sufficient experience to be assigned a job. Would you like to do so?
25.translation_description: Il tuo servitore ha accumulato esperienza a sufficienza per ricevere un job. Vuoi assegnarglielo?

26.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ASK_CHANGE_JOB
26.description: Entrust your copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Vocation<hex:021A020103> to your retainer and bid them learn the ways of the <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8030103>?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Please note that retainers cannot change jobs without resetting all progress.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>
26.translation_description: Vuoi affidare al tuo servitore la tua copia di <hex:021A020203>Vocazione Moderna<hex:021A020103> e fargli apprendere il job <hex:02280EFF09436C6173734A6F62E8030103>?<hex:02100103><hex:02100103><hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ricorda che per cambiare job ai servitori è necessario azzerare tutti i progressi.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>

28.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ASK_RESET_JOB
28.description: Your retainer's copy of <hex:021A020203>Modern Vocation<hex:021A020103> will be permanently discarded. Are you sure you wish to proceed?
28.translation_description: La copia di <hex:021A020203>Vocazione Moderna<hex:021A020103> del tuo servitore verrà distrutta definitivamente. Vuoi davvero procedere?

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ASK_RESET_CLASS_CHECK
30.translation_description: Azzera la classe o il job.

32.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_NO_CLASS_WARNING
32.description: You must select a class for your retainer before you assign a venture.
32.translation_description: Devi scegliere una classe per il tuo servitore prima di assegnargli una spedizione.

42.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_CLASS_EXPLAIN_BATTLE
42.description: As a Disciple of War or Magic, your retainer will be able to undertake hunting and field exploration ventures.
42.translation_description: Se il tuo servitore è un Discepolo della Guerra o della Magia, potrà intraprendere spedizioni di caccia ed esplorazione dei campi.

43.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_CLASS_EXPLAIN_MINER
43.description: As a miner, your retainer will be able to undertake mining and highland exploration ventures.
43.translation_description: Se il tuo servitore è un minatore, potrà intraprendere spedizioni minerarie ed esplorazioni degli altopiani.

44.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_CLASS_EXPLAIN_BOTANIST
44.description: As a botanist, your retainer will be able to undertake botany and woodland exploration ventures.
44.translation_description: Se il tuo servitore è un botanico, potrà intraprendere spedizioni botaniche ed esplorazioni dei boschi.

45.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_CLASS_EXPLAIN_FISHER
45.description: As a fisher, your retainer will be able to undertake fishing and waterside exploration ventures.
45.translation_description: Se il tuo servitore è un pescatore, potrà intraprendere spedizioni di pesca ed esplorazioni delle rive.

46.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_CLASS_NOT_UNLOCKED
46.description: You have not yet unlocked this class and therefore cannot assign it to your retainer.
46.translation_description: Non hai ancora sbloccato questa classe e non puoi assegnarla al tuo servitore.

49.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_PLEASE_SET_CLASS
49.description: You must assign your retainer a class before viewing attributes and gear.
49.translation_description: Devi assegnare una classe al tuo servitore per visualizzarne attributi ed equipaggiamento.

50.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_NO_RESET_DURING_TASK
50.description: You cannot reset the class/job of a retainer with a venture that has not been completed.
50.translation_description: Non puoi azzerare la classe o il job di un servitore finché non ha completato la spedizione.

51.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_RESET_CLASS_QUESTION
51.description: You are about to reset your retainer's class/job. Please note that this process cannot be reversed, and all progress will be permanently lost. Are you certain you wish to proceed?
51.translation_description: Stai per azzerare la classe o il job del tuo servitore. L'operazione è irreversibile e tutti i progressi andranno persi. Vuoi davvero procedere?

52.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ASK_RETURN_WITH_BUYBACK
52.description: Your retainer will be unable to process item buyback requests once recalled. Are you sure you wish to proceed?
52.translation_description: Dopo il richiamo, il tuo servitore non potrà più soddisfare le richieste di riacquisto degli oggetti. Vuoi procedere?

53.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_CURRENCY_CHANGE1
53.description: A venture promissory note cannot be used as is; you must first redeem it for ventures. The amount of ventures you possess is shown in the Currency window.
53.translation_description: Una cambiale per mandati di supporto non può essere usata direttamente: devi prima cambiarla con dei mandati di supporto. Puoi vedere quanti ne possiedi nella finestra Valute.

54.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_RETAINER_TIP_1
54.description: You do not have any ventures in your inventory and therefore cannot assign your retainer a venture.
54.translation_description: Non hai mandati di supporto nell'inventario, quindi non puoi assegnare una spedizione al tuo servitore.

55.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_RETAINER_TIP_2
55.description: Ventures can be acquired through a variety of methods such as exchanging company seals, fulfilling leve objectives, and completing allied society quests.
55.translation_description: Puoi ottenere mandati di supporto in vari modi, per esempio scambiando i sigilli della compagnia, completando obiettivi dei mandati e portando a termine missioni delle Società Alleate.

56.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_RETAINER_TIP_3
56.description: If you possess a venture promissory note, you may redeem it for ventures through a Calamity salvager.
56.translation_description: Se possiedi una cambiale per mandati di supporto, puoi cambiarla con dei mandati di supporto da un rigattiere della calamità.

58.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_FORTUNE_TASK_UNLOCK_1
58.description: Your retainer is now experienced enough to undertake <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>quick exploration ventures<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
58.translation_description: Il tuo servitore ha acquisito esperienza sufficiente per intraprendere <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>spedizioni di esplorazione rapida<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

59.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_FORTUNE_TASK_UNLOCK_2
59.description: Select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>assign venture<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu to proceed.
59.translation_description: Seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Assegna una spedizione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal menu del servitore per continuare.

60.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENABLE_TASK_ORDER_FOR_SIGHT_1
60.description: Check the Companion App for ventures pending completion before assigning a new venture.
60.translation_description: Controlla la Companion App per verificare se ci sono spedizioni da riscuotere prima di assegnarne una nuova.

61.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_INTRO_1
61.description: You can now send your retainers afield on procurement expeditions known as <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>ventures<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
61.translation_description: Ora puoi mandare i tuoi servitori in spedizioni di raccolta note come <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>spedizioni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

62.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_INTRO_2
62.description: Before you can do so, however, you must first assign them a class.
62.translation_description: Prima, però, devi assegnare loro una classe.

63.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_INTRO_3
63.description: After summoning a retainer, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>assign retainer class<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu to begin.
63.translation_description: Dopo aver evocato un servitore, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Assegna una classe al servitore<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal suo menu per iniziare.

64.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_CLASS_1
64.description: Your retainer cannot undertake ventures until you assign his or her class.
64.translation_description: Le spedizioni sono disponibili solo dopo aver assegnato una classe al servitore.

65.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_CLASS_2
65.description: This can be any one class, with the exception of those of the Disciples of the Hand.
65.translation_description: Puoi scegliere qualsiasi classe, tranne quelle dei Discepoli della Mano.

66.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_CLASS_3
66.description: Your retainer's class determines which ventures he or she can embark upon.
66.translation_description: La classe del tuo servitore determina quali spedizioni può intraprendere.

67.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_CLASS_4
67.description: Please be advised that you cannot assign your retainer a class you have not yet unlocked.
67.translation_description: Ricorda che non puoi assegnare al tuo servitore una classe che non hai ancora sbloccato.

69.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_FIRST_CLASS_2
69.description: You must now equip a main arm to your retainer.
69.translation_description: Ora devi equipaggiare un'arma principale al tuo servitore.

70.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_FIRST_CLASS_3
70.description: Select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>view retainer attributes and gear<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu to proceed.
70.translation_description: Seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Visualizza attributi ed equipaggiamento del servitore<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal suo menu per continuare.

72.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_SECOND_CLASS_2
72.description: Please be advised that your retainer must be equipped with a main arm in order to undertake ventures.
72.translation_description: Ricorda che il tuo servitore deve avere un'arma principale equipaggiata per poter intraprendere spedizioni.

73.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_CLASS_RESET_1
73.description: If you wish to assign your retainer a different class, you must first reset his or her current class.
73.translation_description: Se vuoi assegnare al tuo servitore una classe diversa, devi prima azzerare quella attuale.

74.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_CLASS_RESET_2
74.description: If necessary, recall your retainer and remove all gear to proceed.
74.translation_description: Se necessario, richiama il servitore e togligli tutto l'equipaggiamento per continuare.

75.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_EQUIP_1
75.description: You can equip any item in your inventory or Armoury Chest to your retainer, so long as he or she meets the requirements.
75.translation_description: Puoi equipaggiare il tuo servitore con qualsiasi oggetto dell'inventario o dell'Armeria, purché il servitore ne soddisfi i requisiti.

76.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_EQUIP_2
76.description: Equip a main arm to your retainer to proceed.
76.translation_description: Equipaggia un'arma principale al tuo servitore per continuare.

77.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_FIRST_WEAPON_1
77.description: You have equipped a main arm to <hex:022903EA0203>!

78.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_FIRST_WEAPON_2
78.description: Your retainer is now duly prepared to undertake ventures.
78.translation_description: Il tuo servitore è pronto per intraprendere spedizioni.

79.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_FIRST_WEAPON_3
79.description: Select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>assign venture<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu to proceed.
79.translation_description: Seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Assegna una spedizione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal menu del servitore per continuare.

80.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_CLASS_EXPLAIN_START
80.description: As you may recall, the ventures your retainer can undertake are determined by his or her class.
80.translation_description: Come forse ricordi, le spedizioni che il tuo servitore può intraprendere dipendono dalla sua classe.

81.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_VENTURES_1
81.description: There are two main types of ventures which you can assign your retainer.
81.translation_description: Puoi assegnare al tuo servitore due tipi principali di spedizione.

82.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_VENTURES_2
82.description: Hunting, Mining, Botany, and Fishing constitute one type, in which you specify an item for your retainer to procure.
82.translation_description: Caccia, Estrazione mineraria, Botanica e Pesca sono un tipo di spedizione: scegli un oggetto che il tuo servitore dovrà raccogliere.

83.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_VENTURES_3
83.description: Exploration ventures constitute the second type, in which your retainer will scour the terrain of your choosing for (hopefully) precious items.
83.translation_description: Le esplorazioni sono il secondo tipo di spedizione: il tuo servitore perlustrerà la zona che sceglierai alla ricerca di oggetti, si spera preziosi.

84.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_VENTURES_4
84.description: However, your retainer will not undertake a venture without first receiving due compensation.
84.translation_description: Il tuo servitore, però, non partirà senza ricevere il giusto compenso.

85.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_VENTURES_5
85.description: Assigning a venture requires a payment in a unique currency of the same name─<hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>ventures<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
85.translation_description: Per assegnare una spedizione occorre pagare con una valuta speciale che porta lo stesso nome: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>mandati di supporto<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

86.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_VENTURES_6
86.description: Ventures can be acquired through a variety of methods such as exchanging company seals, fulfilling leve objectives, and completing allied society quests.
86.translation_description: Puoi ottenere mandati di supporto in vari modi, per esempio scambiando i sigilli della compagnia, completando obiettivi dei mandati e portando a termine missioni delle Società Alleate.

88.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_FIRST_VENTURE_2
88.description: To confirm the time remaining until a venture is complete, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timers<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> under Duty from the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>main menu<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Ventures<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
88.translation_description: Per controllare quanto manca al termine di una spedizione, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Timer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> nella sezione Incarico del <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Menu Principale<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, quindi apri <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Spedizioni<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

89.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_FIRST_VENTURE_3
89.description: You can also confirm the time remaining by selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>view venture report<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu.
89.translation_description: Puoi controllare il tempo rimanente anche selezionando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Visualizza rapporto della spedizione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal menu del servitore.

90.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_FIRST_VENTURE_4
90.description: Should you wish to cancel the venture and recall your retainer, you may do so when viewing the venture report.
90.translation_description: Se vuoi annullare la spedizione e richiamare il servitore, puoi farlo dalla schermata del rapporto.

91.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_FIRST_VENTURE_5
91.description: However, please be advised that this is not necessary unless you wish to assign a different venture to your retainer.
91.translation_description: Tieni presente che non è necessario farlo, a meno che tu non voglia assegnare al servitore una spedizione diversa.

92.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_FIRST_VENTURE_6
92.description: Even with a venture in progress, you can still entrust or withdraw items and gil, or sell items on the market.
92.translation_description: Anche mentre il servitore è in spedizione, puoi affidargli o ritirare oggetti e gil, oppure vendere oggetti sul mercato.

94.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_FIRST_COMPLETED_2
94.description: To claim the fruits of your retainer's labor, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>view venture report<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the retainer menu.
94.translation_description: Per ritirare i frutti del lavoro del tuo servitore, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Visualizza rapporto della spedizione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal suo menu.

95.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_FINISHED_1
95.description: <hex:022903EA0203> has gained experience for completing a venture!
95.translation_description: <hex:022903EA0203> ha ottenuto esperienza completando una spedizione!

96.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_FINISHED_2
96.description: Like you, your retainer can gain experience and levels.
96.translation_description: Come te, anche il tuo servitore può accumulare esperienza e salire di livello.

97.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_FINISHED_3
97.description: This, in turn, will allow your retainer to undertake a wider variety of ventures, yielding more desirable items.
97.translation_description: Così potrà intraprendere una maggiore varietà di spedizioni e trovare oggetti più preziosi.

98.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_TUTORIAL_FINISHED_4
98.description: Moreover, equipping additional gear to your retainer will increase both the quantity and quality of the items procured.
98.translation_description: Inoltre, se equipaggi il tuo servitore con altro equipaggiamento, aumenteranno la quantità e la qualità degli oggetti raccolti.

99.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_FORTUNE_TASK_1
99.description: Quick exploration ventures are brief assignments in which you dispatch your retainer without instruction.
99.translation_description: Le spedizioni di esplorazione rapida sono incarichi brevi in cui mandi il servitore in esplorazione senza dargli istruzioni.

100.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_FORTUNE_TASK_2
100.description: The items your retainer procures on these ventures can range from worthless to priceless.
100.translation_description: Gli oggetti raccolti dal tuo servitore possono valere poco o essere inestimabili.

101.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_FORTUNE_TASK_3
101.description: Moreover, the experience your retainer receives for completing a quick exploration venture is determined by their level.
101.translation_description: L'esperienza che il servitore ottiene da una spedizione di esplorazione rapida dipende dal suo livello.

102.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_FORTUNE_TASK_4
102.description: Although it is impossible to predict the results of these ventures, the potential benefits should not be underestimated.
102.translation_description: Anche se non puoi prevedere l'esito di queste spedizioni, i possibili vantaggi non vanno sottovalutati.

103.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_MIRAGEPRISM_1
103.description: Glamours can be applied to gear equipped by or in the possession of your retainers.
103.translation_description: Puoi applicare glamour all'equipaggiamento indossato o posseduto dai tuoi servitori.

104.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_MIRAGEPRISM_2
104.description: Moreover, gear equipped by or in the possession of your retainers can be used to apply glamours to your equipped gear, or gear in your inventory.
104.translation_description: Puoi anche usare l'equipaggiamento indossato o posseduto dai tuoi servitori per applicare glamour ai tuoi pezzi equipaggiati o nell'inventario.

105.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_MIRAGEPRISM_3
105.description: Please note a glamour prism is required for each piece of gear you wish to glamour.
105.translation_description: Ricorda che serve un prisma illusorio per ogni pezzo di equipaggiamento a cui vuoi applicare glamour.

106.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ABOUT_EQUIPPAINT_1
106.description: Dyes can be used to change the color of any gear equipped by or in the possession of your retainers.
106.translation_description: Puoi usare le tinte per cambiare il colore di qualsiasi pezzo di equipaggiamento indossato o posseduto dai tuoi servitori.

108.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE2
108.description: Nothin' fer ye to worry about.
108.translation_description: Non c'è niente di cui preoccuparsi.

110.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE4
110.description: Yes? <sigh> I hope this doesn't take long...
110.translation_description: Sì? <sospira> Spero che non ci voglia molto...

111.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
111.description: You wish to see how a master handles a bazaar?
111.translation_description: Vuoi vedere come se la cava un maestro al mercato?

114.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
114.description: What's it to be this time, love?

116.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
116.description: I'm so sorry to keep you waiting, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. So very, very sorry.
116.translation_description: Perdonami per averti fatto aspettare, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>. Mi dispiace davvero, davvero tanto.

117.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
117.description: Quickly now, I've places to be.

118.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
118.description: Well, if it ain't my favorite client! Always a pleasure, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>!
118.translation_description: Ma guarda chi si vede, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>! Sei la persona che preferisco servire. È sempre un piacere!

120.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
120.description: What's on the agenda, chief? Deprivin' saps o' their hard-earned gil?
120.translation_description: Che si fa oggi, capo? Spogliamo qualche allocco dei gil guadagnati con fatica?

121.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE3
121.description: I have come. You may proceed.

122.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE4
122.description: Oh, hello there. To what do I owe the pleasure?
122.translation_description: Oh, salve! A cosa devo il piacere?

123.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE5
123.description: I am come to conduct business, and only business.
123.translation_description: Sono qui per fare affari, e soltanto affari.

124.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
124.description: You look to be in good health, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. How may I assist you this fine <hex:02082EE3E90C0DFF14020810E3E90C05FF04657665FF056D6F726E03FF1302080FE3E90C12FF04646179FF046576650303>?

125.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
125.description: What is it you would have me do, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>?

126.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
126.description: Usually, it's me doin' the summons and others doin' the waitin'.
126.translation_description: Di solito sono io a chiamare e gli altri ad aspettare.

127.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE3
127.description: Is there something that I can help you with?

128.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
128.description: Oh, why must you summon me at a time like this...?

129.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
129.description: I'm sure there is a perfectly good explanation for this summons.
129.translation_description: Ci sarà senz'altro una buona ragione per avermi chiamato.

130.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
130.description: You know, I thought you might be along to summon me. You may rest assured that I am ready and eager to serve.
130.translation_description: Sai, pensavo che prima o poi mi avresti chiamato. Puoi contare su di me: non vedo l'ora di servirti.

131.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
131.description: Hail to thee, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Your humble servant has heard your summons.
131.translation_description: Salute a te, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>. Il tuo umile servitore ha udito la tua chiamata.

132.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
132.description: Greetin's and salutations, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>. Pray speak yer desires, an' I'll do me damndest to see 'em done.
132.translation_description: Saluti, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>! Dimmi cosa desideri e farò del mio meglio per accontentarti.

133.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE3
133.description: I was wondering when you'd get around to calling me.
133.translation_description: Mi chiedevo quando ti saresti deciso a chiamarmi.

134.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
134.description: Mind if we keep this brief? I've got a pretty little thing that's waitin' for me.
134.translation_description: Facciamola breve? Mi aspetta una bella compagnia.

137.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE1
137.description: Here I am, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>, as per your request.

138.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
138.translation_description: Salve, tesoro. Che c'è in programma?

139.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
139.description: I never miss a chance to line these pockets.
139.translation_description: Non mi lascio mai sfuggire l'occasione di riempirmi le tasche.

140.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
140.description: Well, this is unexpected! What'll it be?
140.translation_description: Beh, non me l'aspettavo! Che si fa?

143.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE1
143.description: How may I be of serrrvice, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>?

144.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
144.description: It's a war out there, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. You have no idea.
144.translation_description: Là fuori è una guerra, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503>. Non hai idea.

147.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
147.description: I presume you did not summon me solely for the pleasure of my company.
147.translation_description: Immagino che tu non mi abbia chiamato solo per goderti la mia compagnia.

148.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
148.description: Just the <hex:020821E905FF0C66616972206D616964656EFF1068616E64736F6D652066656C6C6F7703> I was hoping to see! Tell me your heart's desire.
148.translation_description: Oh! Proprio <hex:02082AE905FF136C612062656C6C612066616E6369756C6C61FF12696C2062656C2067696F76616E6F74746F03> che speravo di vedere! Dimmi, qual è il tuo desiderio?

149.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE1
149.description: I hope your catcall is not one of disapproval.
149.translation_description: Spero che il tuo richiamo non esprima disapprovazione.

151.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
151.description: A cat's ears do not miss much―least of all a summons.
151.translation_description: A un gatto non sfugge molto, soprattutto una chiamata.

152.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
152.description: Curiosity called the cat. What do you have for me today?
152.translation_description: La curiosità ha chiamato il gatto. Cosa mi porti oggi?

154.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
154.description: I was just thinking of you!

155.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
155.description: What need have you of me today, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>?

156.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
156.description: Bwahahaha! Ye got work needs gettin' done? Just point me in the right bloody direction.
156.translation_description: Ahahah! Hai del lavoro da sbrigare? Dimmi dove andare e ci penso io, dannazione!

158.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
158.description: Hey there─hic─<hex:020810E905FF066D69737379FF056D61746503>! Care to join me fer a pint?

159.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
159.description: Couldn't come no quicker. Where's the work?
159.translation_description: Non potevo arrivare prima. Dov'è il lavoro?

160.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
160.description: I came runnin' soon as I heard the bell! Ye need somethin', chief?
160.translation_description: Appena ho sentito la campana, eccomi subito qui! Ti serve qualcosa, capo?

162.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE2
162.description: Ye got somethin' fer me, cap'n?

164.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
164.description: Let's keep this short and sweet, shall we?
164.translation_description: Facciamola breve e indolore, che ne dici?

165.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
165.description: This wouldn't be necessary if you entrusted your financial affairs to me.
165.translation_description: Non sarebbe necessario se affidassi a me i tuoi affari finanziari.

166.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
166.description: So─sellin', buyin', drinkin', whorin'? What's it to be today?
166.translation_description: Dunque: oggi si vende, si compra, si beve o si va a prostitute?

167.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
167.description: Greetings, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. How may I be of service?

172.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
172.description: We work the market stalls,♪<hex:02100103>And our uniforms are pretty;♪<hex:02100103>We are sober men and true,♪<hex:02100103>And attentive to our duties!♪
172.translation_description: Lavoriamo ai banchi del mercato,♪<hex:02100103>E le nostre divise sono belle;♪<hex:02100103>Siamo sobri e leali,♪<hex:02100103>E ligi al nostro dovere!♪

173.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
173.description: <hex:020815E905FF084D79206C616479FF084D79206C6F726403>. What would you ask of me?

176.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
176.description: Hey, it's...it's you! Hello again, you!
176.translation_description: Ehi, ma... sei tu! Ciao di nuovo!

177.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
177.description: I-It's not like I want to sell your items or anything.
177.translation_description: N-Non è che mi piaccia vendere i tuoi oggetti, eh.

178.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
178.description: What do you have for me? Come on, come on! Don't be shy!
178.translation_description: Che cosa hai per me? Dai, dai! Non essere timido!

180.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE2
180.description: I trust this will be worth my while.
180.translation_description: Spero che ne valga la pena.

182.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE4
182.description: Whatever you need, leave it to me! I have my methods.
182.translation_description: Qualunque cosa ti serva, lascia fare a me! Ho i miei metodi.

183.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE5
183.description: Gahaha! If it isn't my favorite <hex:020815E905FF096D69737472657373FF076D617374657203>!
183.translation_description: Ahahaha! Ma guarda chi si vede, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>! Non poteva capitarmi un cliente migliore!

184.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE6
184.description: It is I, your most loyal and capable retainer!
184.translation_description: Sono il tuo servitore più leale e capace!

186.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE2
186.description: At your beck an' call, I am!

187.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE3
187.description: You called, and I have come.

188.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE4
188.description: At last─I thought you'd <hex:021A020203>never<hex:021A020103> call. What does <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403> need of me?
188.translation_description: Finalmente... pensavo che non mi avresti <hex:021A020203>mai<hex:021A020103> chiamato. Cosa ti serve, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>?

189.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE5
189.description: Could it be...? The famous <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> has called on <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>? <chuckle>
189.translation_description: Davvero...? La celebrità <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> ha chiamato proprio <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>? <ridacchia>

190.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE6
190.description: Yes, yes, here I am! Ready at a moment's notice!
190.translation_description: Sì, sì, eccomi! Sempre a disposizione, in un attimo!

192.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE2
192.description: Your orders! I would hear them at once!

193.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE3
193.description: If there is something you would ask of me, then ask it.
193.translation_description: Se vuoi chiedermi qualcosa, chiedi pure.

195.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE5
195.description: A task for me? I hope it's something fun!
195.translation_description: Un incarico per me? Spero sia divertente!

196.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE6
196.description: I am here to do your every bidding, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>! Ask of me anything at all!
196.translation_description: Sono qui per esaudire ogni tuo desiderio, <hex:020815E905FF085369676E6F7261FF085369676E6F726503>! Chiedimi pure qualunque cosa!

197.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_VIERA_MALE_TYPE1
197.description: I have been awaiting your summons, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. What would you have of me this fine <hex:020839E3E90C0DFF1B020817E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF086D6F726E696E6703FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303>?
197.translation_description: Attendevo la tua chiamata, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>. Che cosa posso fare per te in questa splendida <hex:020838E3E90C0DFF18020814E3E90C05FF0573657261FF086D617474696E6103FF19020815E3E90C12FF0967696F726E617461FF05736572610303>?

201.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_VIERA_MALE_TYPE5
201.description: Need my assistance, do you? Let's make this quick, then.
201.translation_description: Ti serve il mio aiuto? Facciamo in fretta, allora.

202.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_VIERA_MALE_TYPE6
202.description: You have my ear, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>. Both of them, in fact!
202.translation_description: Ti ascolto, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>. Con entrambe le orecchie, per giunta!

203.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE1
203.description: If that is all, I will take my leave now, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>.
203.translation_description: Se non hai altro, <hex:020815E905FF085369676E6F7261FF085369676E6F726503>, tolgo il disturbo.

207.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
207.description: I believe thanks are in order.
207.translation_description: Direi che un ringraziamento è d'obbligo.

210.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
210.description: Don't you worry 'bout a thing. I got this.

212.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
212.description: If there is nothing else, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, I'll be going now.

213.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
213.description: Is that all? Very well, until next time.

214.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
214.description: Oh, will that be all today? Very well, but promise me you'll come back soon!
214.translation_description: È tutto per oggi? Va bene, ma promettimi che tornerai presto!

215.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE1
215.description: As always, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, it has been an honor and a privilege.
215.translation_description: Come sempre, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>, è stato un onore e un privilegio.

216.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
216.description: You can count on me, chief─I know how to get things done.
216.translation_description: Conta su di me, capo: so come portare a termine il lavoro.

218.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE4
218.description: I swear it shall be done. Eventually.
218.translation_description: Ti giuro che sarà fatto. Prima o poi.

220.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
220.description: Capital! I shall carry out your orders forthwith.
220.translation_description: Benissimo! Eseguirò subito i tuoi ordini.

221.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
221.description: I humbly await your next summons, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.
221.translation_description: Attenderò umilmente la tua prossima chiamata, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>.

222.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
222.description: Don't leave me alone for too long, hear?
222.translation_description: Non lasciarmi da sola troppo a lungo, capito?

224.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
224.description: That will be all, yes? Then if you would excuse me...
224.translation_description: È tutto, vero? Allora, con permesso...

225.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
225.description: I believe that concludes our dealings for now.
225.translation_description: Direi che per ora abbiamo concluso.

226.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
226.description: Are you certain you don't desire anything else? Anything at all? Very well, I shall take my leave.
226.translation_description: Sei sicuro di non volere altro? Qualunque cosa? Va bene, allora mi congedo.

227.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
227.description: Your every whim shall be swiftly carried out with due care and consideration.
227.translation_description: Esaudirò ogni tuo desiderio con sollecitudine e cura.

228.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
228.description: Shouldn't take more than a moment, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.

230.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
230.description: Thank the gods we're finished. I've got plans to put my hands in places I've never seen...if you know what I mean.
230.translation_description: Meno male che abbiamo finito. Ho già in mente dei posti dove infilare le mani... posti mai raggiunti prima. Se capisci cosa intendo.

232.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE6
232.translation_description: Me ne vado, me ne vado!

234.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
234.description: Blessin's o' the Twelve upon ye.
234.translation_description: Le benedizioni dei Dodici siano con te.

235.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
235.description: May Nald'thal see fit to fatten our pockets!
235.translation_description: Possa Nald'thal gonfiare le nostre tasche!

236.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
236.description: Very good, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>! Your wish is my command, and so forth.
236.translation_description: Benissimo, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>! Il tuo desiderio è un ordine, e così via.

237.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE5
237.description: You know how to reach me.

238.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE6
238.description: Is it time for good-byes already? I'm going to miss you...
238.translation_description: È già ora di salutarci? Mi mancherai...

240.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
240.description: The markets may be a bleedin' battlefield, but I'm a godsdamned soldier. You can count on me, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.
240.translation_description: Il mercato sarà anche un campo di battaglia sanguinoso, ma io sono un soldato maledetto. Conta su di me, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

242.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
242.description: Why so serrrious? <sigh> So it goes.

243.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
243.description: I hardly think that warranted my personal appearance, but what is done is done.
243.translation_description: Non credo fosse necessario che venissi di persona, ma ormai è fatta.

244.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
244.description: Then I have satisfied your every need? Excellent! I do so take pleasure in servicing my clients.
244.translation_description: Ho soddisfatto ogni tuo desiderio? Ottimo! Mi piace proprio... servire i miei clienti.

246.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
246.description: Right then, let's get on with it!

247.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
247.description: There is no call for concerrrn.

248.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
248.description: When the master's away, the cat will play.
248.translation_description: Quando il padrone è lontano, il gatto si dà alla pazza gioia.

250.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
250.description: You don't want to be with me anymore? <sniffle>
250.translation_description: Non vuoi più stare con me? <tira su col naso>

251.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
251.description: I shall carry out your wishes as instructed, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

252.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
252.description: Bwahahaha! I'm in yer bazaar, sellin' yer wares!
252.translation_description: Eccomi nel tuo bazar, a vendere la tua mercanzia!

254.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
254.description: Awww, bugger. Reckon I best get to work...
254.translation_description: Uffa, accidenti. Mi sa che è ora di mettermi al lavoro...

256.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
256.description: Go and grab yourself some shut-eye, chief. You look terrible!
256.translation_description: Vai a farti una dormita, capo. Hai una pessima cera!

257.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE1
257.description: Will that be all for today, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>? Understood.

260.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
260.description: Not exactly how I was hopin' to spend my day, but I suppose it can't be helped.
260.translation_description: Non è proprio il modo in cui speravo di passare la giornata, ma non posso farci nulla.

261.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
261.description: Ours is not to reason why. Ours is but to do and die.
261.translation_description: Non sta a noi chiedere perché; a noi non resta che fare e morire.

262.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
262.description: Ever the consummate professional, I see. Another time, then.
262.translation_description: Vedo che non perdi mai la tua professionalità. Sarà per un'altra volta, allora.

263.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
263.description: If there is nothing else, then I shall take my leave.
263.translation_description: Se non hai altro da chiedermi, mi congedo.

264.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
264.description: Is that all? Guess I'll be on my way, then.

265.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
265.description: Any last requests? Very well. Heh heh heh... Ahem.
265.translation_description: Un'ultima richiesta? Va bene. Eh eh eh... Ehm.

266.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
266.description: Ah, yes, of course. Duty calls!
266.translation_description: Ah, certo. Il dovere mi chiama!

267.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
267.description: You are finished with me, then?

268.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
268.description: Here today and gone tomorrow;♪<hex:02100103>Yes, I know─♪<hex:02100103>That is so!♪
268.translation_description: Oggi qui e domani via,♪<hex:02100103>Sì, lo so...♪<hex:02100103>È proprio così!♪

269.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
269.description: If ever you have need of me, just ring.
269.translation_description: Se hai bisogno di me, suona.

272.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
272.description: Finished already? Guess that's that, then.

273.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
273.description: You're leaving already? Fine, then! I-It's not like I wanted you to stay or anything.
273.translation_description: Te ne vai già? Va bene! C-Come se volessi che restassi.

276.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE2
276.description: Hmph. I hope that next time you will have a more meaningful task for me.
276.translation_description: Umpf. Spero che la prossima volta tu abbia un incarico più significativo per me.

278.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE4
278.description: And with that, I shall be off. Places to go, people to see.
278.translation_description: Allora vado. Ho posti da visitare e gente da vedere.

279.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE5
279.description: Bahahaha! Till next time, my friend!

280.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE6
280.description: Ring for me whenever you please! You know that I will never let you down!
280.translation_description: Chiamami quando vuoi! Sai che non ti deluderò mai!

281.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE1
281.description: I'm glad to have been of service. Mind you don't overdo things, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.
281.translation_description: Che piacere esserti utile. Non strafare, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

282.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE2
282.description: Had your fill of me, eh? Fair enough! Let me know if you need aught else!
282.translation_description: Ne hai avuto abbastanza di me, eh? Va bene! Dimmi se ti serve altro!

283.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE3
283.description: We're done? Then I take my leave.

284.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE4
284.description: There's naught else <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403> requires? I'll be sharpening my claws, then, waiting for your next summons.
284.translation_description: Non ti serve altro, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>? Affilerò gli artigli in attesa della tua prossima chiamata.

285.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE5
285.description: Nothing else? Right... I'll be off!

286.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE6
286.description: Have everything you need? I'll take a little nap, then.
286.translation_description: Hai tutto quello che ti serve? Allora schiaccio un pisolino.

289.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE3
289.description: Call on me as you please. If I am so inclined, I will answer.
289.translation_description: Chiamami quando vuoi. Se ne avrò voglia, risponderò.

290.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE4
290.description: That is all, I suppose...? <yawn> Very well...

291.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE5
291.description: That is all? Oh, I was hoping there'd be more...
291.translation_description: È tutto? Oh, speravo ci fosse altro...

292.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE6
292.description: Is that all you need of me? But I could yet serve you in so many ways!
292.translation_description: È tutto ciò che ti serve da me? Potrei servirti in tanti altri modi!

293.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE1
293.description: Do not hesitate to call upon me again. Fare you well in your endeavors, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.
293.translation_description: Non esitare a chiamarmi di nuovo. Buona fortuna nelle tue imprese, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

294.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE2
294.description: Just say the word, yer <hex:020817E905FF096C61647973686970FF096C6F72647368697003>, and I'll be here with bells on.

295.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE3
295.description: If you have no further need of my services...
295.translation_description: Se non hai più bisogno dei miei servizi...

296.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE4
296.description: I'm off for another glass, then. You know where to find me!
296.translation_description: Allora vado a bermi un altro bicchiere. Sai dove trovarmi!

297.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE5
297.description: What─is that it? Are you <hex:021A020203>sure<hex:021A020103> you need a retainer?
297.translation_description: Tutto qui? Sei proprio <hex:021A020203>sicuro<hex:021A020103> di aver bisogno di un servitore?

298.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE6
298.description: Nothing else? Then I shall be hopping along.

300.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE2
300.description: Easy now, easy. I'm on it.
300.translation_description: Calma, calma. Me ne occupo io.

303.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
303.description: I shall see to things from here.

306.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
306.description: Hah! I'll be back afore you know it.
306.translation_description: Ah! Torno prima che tu te ne accorga.

307.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE3
307.description: If that is what you would ask of me.
307.translation_description: Se è questo ciò che mi chiedi.

309.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
309.description: Your enterprise is in capable hands, I assure you.
309.translation_description: Ti garantisco che la tua impresa è in buone mani.

312.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
312.description: No need to worry, chief─this is where I shine.
312.translation_description: Non preoccuparti, capo: qui posso dare il meglio di me.

315.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE5
315.description: Good. I prefer to work alone.
315.translation_description: Bene. Preferisco lavorare per conto mio.

316.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
316.description: Ahhh, I do so enjoy the occasional excursion!
316.translation_description: Ah, adoro concedermi ogni tanto una piccola gita!

317.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
317.description: As you ask, so shall it be done, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.

318.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
318.description: Work to be done, eh? All right, then.
318.translation_description: C'è del lavoro da fare? Va bene, allora.

320.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
320.description: A venture? <hex:021A020203>Now<hex:021A020103>? Well, if you insist.
320.translation_description: Una spedizione? <hex:021A020203>Adesso<hex:021A020103>? Va bene, se insisti.

321.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
321.description: I am well aware of how this works.

322.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
322.description: That sounds like fun! You'll be joining me, yes? <hex:021A020203>No<hex:021A020103>? Oh.
322.translation_description: Sembra divertente! Verrai con me, vero? <hex:021A020203>No<hex:021A020103>? Ah.

326.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
326.description: Hope you ain't expectin' me to rush. I wanna take it nice and slow.
326.translation_description: Non aspettarti che mi sbrighi. Voglio prendermela con calma.

327.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE5
327.description: I think I can manage from here.

328.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE6
328.description: I'll do it, I'll do it!

329.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE1
329.description: It is an honor to serve you, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>.

330.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
330.description: Is that all? A triflin' task!
330.translation_description: Tutto qui? Un compitino da nulla!

331.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
331.description: If there's profit to be made, I'll make it.
331.translation_description: Se c'è da guadagnare, ci penso io.

332.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
332.description: My every waking minute will be spent working on your behalf, et cetera.
332.translation_description: Dedicherò ogni minuto di veglia a lavorare per te, e così via.

333.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE5
333.description: Fine...for now. But you're asking a bit much, considering what I'm paid.
333.translation_description: Va bene... per stavolta. Ma mi stai chiedendo un po' troppo, per quello che mi paghi.

334.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE6
334.translation_description: È il mio momento, eh eh!

335.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE1
335.description: Excellent decision, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Venturrres are my specialty.
335.translation_description: Ottima scelta, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>. Le spedizioni sono la mia specialità.

336.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
336.description: A special solo mission? Hells, why didn't you say so sooner! Of course I'll do it!
336.translation_description: Una missione in solitaria? Accidenti, perché non me l'hai detto prima? Certo che lo farò!

338.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
338.description: Business. Always business with you. Fine...
338.translation_description: Affari. Sempre e solo affari con te. Va bene...

339.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
339.description: Leave me to my task, and we shall both be satisfied.
339.translation_description: Lasciami al mio compito e saremo entrambi soddisfatti.

340.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
340.description: You will be most pleased with the result. I guarantee it!
340.translation_description: Il risultato ti piacerà, te lo garantisco!

342.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
342.description: Ah, I was in the mood for a jaunt outside!
342.translation_description: Ah, mi andava proprio di fare una passeggiata fuori!

344.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
344.description: I'll start now, if that's what you want.
344.translation_description: Comincio subito, se è quello che vuoi.

345.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE5
345.description: Not quite <hex:021A020203>ad<hex:021A020103>venturin', but it's close enough.
345.translation_description: Non è proprio <hex:021A020203>una spedizione<hex:021A020103>, ma ci siamo quasi.

346.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
346.description: I'll do anything you say, exactly as you say.
346.translation_description: Farò qualunque cosa tu mi chieda, esattamente come vuoi.

347.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
347.description: I shall not keep you waiting overlong, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

348.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
348.description: Bwahahaha! So that's what this is about! I'll handle it!
348.translation_description: Ahahah! Ecco di che si tratta! Ci penso io!

351.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
351.description: I can go now, right? Great.

352.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
352.description: I'll give it everything I've got, chief!

354.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE2
354.description: Ye picked the right woman fer the job, cap'n!
354.translation_description: Hai scelto la donna giusta per il lavoro, capitano!

356.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
356.description: Oh, for the love of─ Really? Godsdammit.
356.translation_description: Oh, per l'amor di... Davvero? Accidenti!

357.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
357.description: I see you finally have the good sense to grant me greater autonomy.
357.translation_description: Vedo che finalmente hai il buon senso di concedermi maggiore autonomia.

358.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
358.description: Oho, so it's venturin', it is! This ought to be fun.
358.translation_description: Oh, quindi si parte per una spedizione, eh? Sarà divertente.

359.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
359.description: Neither rain nor sleet nor ferocious beasts shall keep me from my task.
359.translation_description: Né pioggia né neve né bestie feroci mi impediranno di portare a termine il mio incarico.

360.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
360.description: Venture, eh? Ain't nothin' to it.
360.translation_description: Una spedizione? Non c'è niente di più facile.

361.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
361.description: Oh, I'll get busy. I'll get very busy, indeed.
361.translation_description: Mi metto al lavoro. E ci darò dentro, eccome.

362.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
362.description: What? I mean, I'm flattered you think I can handle it, but...
362.translation_description: Cosa? Cioè, mi fa piacere che tu pensi che sia in grado, ma...

363.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
363.description: I don't recall this being part of my contract...
363.translation_description: Non ricordo che fosse previsto dal mio contratto...

364.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
364.description: A simple retainer, lowly born,♪<hex:02100103>Unlettered and unknown,♪<hex:02100103>Who toils for bread from early morn,♪<hex:02100103>Till half the night has flown!♪
364.translation_description: Un umile servitore, di origini modeste,♪<hex:02100103>Senza istruzione né fama,♪<hex:02100103>Lavora per guadagnarsi il pane dall'alba,♪<hex:02100103>Fino a notte inoltrata!♪

366.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE2
366.description: Sure, why not? I'll give it a go!

368.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
368.description: I'll do it! I'll rob the─ I mean, er, what you said.
368.translation_description: Lo farò! Rapinerò... cioè, volevo dire, farò come hai detto.

369.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
369.description: A v-venture!? Great! It's not like I would rather spend time with you or anything.
369.translation_description: U-Una spedizione!? Che bello! Non che preferirei passare del tempo con te, o qualcosa del genere.

370.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
370.description: Oh, a challenge! Far be it from me to deny you!
370.translation_description: Oh, una sfida! Non potrei mai rifiutarti!

371.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE1
371.description: Your every wish is my command.
371.translation_description: Ogni tuo desiderio è un ordine.

372.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE2
372.description: I will perform your menial task.
372.translation_description: Eseguirò questo tuo compito di poco conto.

374.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE4
374.description: No worries, boss. Consider it done.

375.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE5
375.description: Gahahaha! It's as good as done!

376.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE6
376.description: But of course! Your favorite retainer would be <hex:021A020203>more<hex:021A020103> than happy to do that!
376.translation_description: Ma certo! Il tuo servitore preferito sarebbe <hex:021A020203>più<hex:021A020103> che felice di occuparsene!

377.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE1
377.description: Time to get to work, is it? I'll do my best to return with good news.
377.translation_description: Ora si lavora, eh? Farò del mio meglio e spero di tornare con buone notizie.

378.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE2
378.description: Say no more. It's all under control!
378.translation_description: Non aggiungere altro. È tutto sotto controllo!

380.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE4
380.description: I suppose I had best be going! I'd never wish to disappoint <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.
380.translation_description: Mi sa che è meglio andare! Non vorrei <hex:021A020203>deluderti<hex:021A020103>, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

381.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE5
381.description: I'll do it, but only because it's you asking, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You should feel special! <chuckle>
381.translation_description: Lo faccio solo perché me lo chiedi tu, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Dovresti sentirti importante! <ridacchia>

382.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE6
382.description: Understood! I'll take care of it!

385.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE3
385.description: A less-than-stimulating task, but I will acquiesce.
385.translation_description: Un compito poco stimolante, ma obbedirò.

387.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE5
387.description: That certainly sounds interesting! Well, I'd best be on my way!
387.translation_description: Sembra davvero interessante! Beh, è meglio che mi metta in marcia!

388.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE6
388.description: If that is your heart's desire, then so it shall be!
388.translation_description: Se è questo che desideri, così sarà!

389.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_VIERA_MALE_TYPE1
389.description: As you have commanded, so I will see it done!
389.translation_description: Come hai comandato, così sarà fatto!

392.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_VIERA_MALE_TYPE4
392.description: But of course, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>! I'm not as─hic─unsteady as all that!
392.translation_description: Ma certo, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503>! Non barcollo così tanto... *hic* come credi!

393.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_VIERA_MALE_TYPE5
393.description: I'll take care of it. Just as long as you're suitably grateful.
393.translation_description: Me ne occupo io. A patto che tu sappia esserne riconoscente.

394.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_VIERA_MALE_TYPE6
394.description: I'll see it done in two shakes of a rabbit's tail!
394.translation_description: Te lo faccio in un battibaleno... di coniglio!

395.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE1
395.description: I pray this meets with your satisfaction, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>.
395.translation_description: Spero che il risultato sia di tuo gradimento, <hex:020815E905FF085369676E6F7261FF085369676E6F726503>.

398.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE4
398.description: Let's not do this again for a while, shall we?
398.translation_description: Cerchiamo di non rifarlo per un po', va bene?

399.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
399.description: Do not behave as though you are not impressed.
399.translation_description: Non fingere che non ti abbia impressionato.

402.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
402.description: How do you like me now, love?

405.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
405.description: Of course it was a success. Did you doubt me?
405.translation_description: Ovviamente è stato un successo. Dubitavi di me?

406.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
406.description: I think that went well, don't you?
406.translation_description: Direi che è andata bene, no?

408.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
408.description: A rousin' success, if I do say so myself.
408.translation_description: Un successo strepitoso, se posso dirlo!

411.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE5
411.description: I trust you have no complaints? Good.
411.translation_description: Spero che tu non abbia nulla da ridire. Bene.

412.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
412.description: What I wouldn't give to do this all the time!

414.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
414.description: One day it'll be me givin' the orders.
414.translation_description: Un giorno sarò io a dare gli ordini.

415.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE3
415.description: Let me know when you want me to handle another.
415.translation_description: Dimmi quando vuoi che me ne occupi di nuovo.

416.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
416.description: A thoroughly pedestrian result, I'm afraid. I would understand if you decided not to assign me ventures henceforth.
416.translation_description: Il risultato è piuttosto ordinario, temo. Capirei se da ora in poi decidessi di non affidarmi più spedizioni.

419.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
419.description: Your humble servant hopes that you find the fruits of his labor acceptable.
419.translation_description: Il tuo umile servitore spera che il frutto del suo lavoro ti soddisfi.

420.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
420.description: Could be better, but could be worse.
420.translation_description: Poteva andare meglio, ma anche peggio.

422.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
422.description: I knew I could satisfy your needs.
422.translation_description: Sapevo che avrei potuto soddisfare le tue richieste.

425.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE1
425.description: My only regret is that I could not return sooner.

427.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
427.description: 'Twas a most profitable venture, I'd say.
427.translation_description: Direi che è stata una spedizione molto redditizia.

428.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
428.description: Always a pleasure to serve, and so on and so forth.
428.translation_description: È sempre un piacere servirti, e così via.

430.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE6
430.description: Some of my finest work yet!

431.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE1
431.description: It is an honor to serrrve, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

434.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
434.description: Why don't we both take it easy for a while?
434.translation_description: Perché non ci rilassiamo un po'?

435.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
435.description: And with that, we can move on to more important matters.
435.translation_description: E con questo possiamo passare a questioni più importanti.

436.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
436.description: Was it everything you hoped it would be?

438.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
438.description: Just what ye wanted, am I right?
438.translation_description: È proprio quello che volevi, vero?

439.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
439.translation_description: Grazie per esserti affidato a me.

441.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE5
441.description: And that's the end of that chapter.
441.translation_description: E anche questo capitolo è chiuso.

443.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
443.description: If you require aught else, you need only ask.
443.translation_description: Se ti serve altro, chiedi pure.

446.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
446.description: Why don't we toast our success with a pint or two?
446.translation_description: Perché non brindiamo al nostro successo con una pinta o due?

447.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
447.description: If you want, I can undertake another one right now.
447.translation_description: Se vuoi, posso partire subito per un'altra spedizione.

448.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
448.description: It's all there, chief. Ye have me word.
448.translation_description: C'è tutto, capo. Hai la mia parola.

449.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE1
449.translation_description: Spero che il risultato ti soddisfi, <hex:02081DE905FF0C4D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C4D696F207369676E6F726503>.

450.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE2
450.description: A good haul, all in all.

452.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
452.translation_description: Spero proprio che ti vada dannatamente bene.

453.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
453.description: You yourself could do no better.
453.translation_description: Non avresti saputo fare di meglio.

455.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
455.description: I pray that you are pleased with the result, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.
455.translation_description: Spero che il risultato ti soddisfi, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

456.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
456.description: Bet you weren't expecting <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> now, were you?
456.translation_description: Scommetto che non ti aspettavi <hex:021A020203>questo<hex:021A020103>, eh?

457.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
457.description: Ah, for the days when ventures were a gentleman's pursuit...
457.translation_description: Ah, bei tempi quelli in cui le spedizioni erano un'attività da gentiluomini...

458.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
458.description: If you don't mind me saying, I think I did rather well.
458.translation_description: Se posso dirlo, credo di aver fatto un buon lavoro.

459.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
459.description: I will be expected to do this again, I gather.

460.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
460.description: Can I survive this overbearing,♪<hex:02100103>Or live a life of mad despairing,♪<hex:02100103>My proffered goods despised, rejected?♪<hex:02100103>No, no, it's not to be expected!♪
460.translation_description: Riuscirò a sopportare questo tormento,♪<hex:02100103>O vivrò nella disperazione?♪<hex:02100103>I miei doni, disprezzati e rifiutati?♪<hex:02100103>No, no, non può accadere!♪

462.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE2
462.description: All's well that ends well, wouldn't you say?
462.translation_description: Tutto è bene quel che finisce bene, non credi?

464.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
464.description: All acquired in accordance with local laws. <wink> <wink>
464.translation_description: Tutto acquistato nel rispetto delle leggi locali. <ammicca> <ammicca>

465.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
465.description: Alright, take yer shite and quit leerin' at me arse.<hex:02100103>...What? Ye can't seriously expect me to humor yer fetishes all the time, can ye?
465.translation_description: Va bene, prendi questa roba e smettila di fissarmi il sedere.<hex:02100103>...Cosa? Non penserai mica che assecondi sempre le tue perversioni, vero?

466.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
466.description: Hardly my finest work, but I'm not ashamed to say I did it.
466.translation_description: Non è certo il mio lavoro migliore, ma non mi vergogno di dire che l'ho fatto.

468.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE2
468.description: This is what you asked for, yes? So take it.
