468.translation_description: È questo che volevi? E allora prendilo.

470.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE4
470.description: Here's what you wanted! And, er...let us focus on the <hex:021A020203>what<hex:021A020103> and not talk about the <hex:021A020203>how<hex:021A020103>, yes?
470.translation_description: Ecco quello che volevi! Ehm... limitiamoci al <hex:021A020203>cosa<hex:021A020103>, senza parlare del <hex:021A020203>come<hex:021A020103>, d'accordo?

472.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE6
472.description: Look what I brought, just for you!
472.translation_description: Guarda cosa ti ho portato, apposta per te!

473.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE1
473.description: I hope my performance was to your satisfaction, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.
473.translation_description: Spero che il mio lavoro sia stato di tuo gradimento, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

474.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE2
474.description: This is the part where I give you the good news. Here─get an eyeful of that!
474.translation_description: Ed ecco il momento delle buone notizie. Guarda qui!

476.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE4
476.description: Well? Have I made you happy? I do so <hex:021A020203>love<hex:021A020103> to see you smile.
476.translation_description: Allora, ti ho reso felice? Mi <hex:021A020203>piace<hex:021A020103> tanto vederti sorridere.

477.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE5
477.description: I did what you asked. Now, where's my words of praise? <chuckle>
477.translation_description: Ho fatto quello che mi hai chiesto. E ora, dov'è il mio elogio? <ridacchia>

478.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE6
478.description: Take a look! A perfect performance, if I do say so myself!
478.translation_description: Guarda! Una prestazione perfetta, se posso dirlo!

479.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE1
479.description: I do hope it pleases you.

480.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE2
480.description: Behold! This is what you seek, yes!?
480.translation_description: Ecco! È proprio questo che cercavi, vero!?

481.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE3
481.description: I believe this is what you sought of me.
481.translation_description: Credo che fosse proprio questo che volevi da me.

482.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE4
482.description: The deed is done. <yawn> Now, time for a rest...
482.translation_description: È fatto. <sbadiglia> E ora, un po' di riposo...

483.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE5
483.description: Well? Do you like it? Oh, say that you do!
483.translation_description: Allora? Ti piace? Oh, dimmi di sì!

484.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE6
484.description: Behold the fruits of my labor! I do hope it is everything you expected.
484.translation_description: Ecco il frutto del mio lavoro! Spero sia tutto quello che ti aspettavi.

485.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE1
485.description: I trust this meets with your satisfaction, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>? After all, your contented smile is my greatest reward!
485.translation_description: Spero sia di tuo gradimento, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>. Il tuo sorriso soddisfatto è la mia ricompensa più grande!

486.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE2
486.description: Does that meet with <hex:02081FE905FF0D686572206C61647973686970FF0D686973206C6F72647368697003>'s approval? (It bloody better...)
486.translation_description: Spero che il risultato sia approvato da <hex:020825E905FF10566F73747261205369676E6F726961FF10566F73747261205369676E6F72696103>. (E lo sarà, dannazione...)

487.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE3
487.description: No need to thank me, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Fulfilling one's duty is its own reward.
487.translation_description: Non ringraziarmi, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>. Fare il proprio dovere è già una ricompensa.

488.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE4
488.description: Not bad, eh? In fact, I think we should pop a cork to celebrate!
488.translation_description: Niente male, eh? Dovremmo stappare una bottiglia per festeggiare!

489.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE5
489.description: This is what you wanted, yes? I told you I'd take care of it.
489.translation_description: È quello che volevi, vero? Ti avevo detto che me ne sarei occupato.

490.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_VIERA_MALE_TYPE6
490.description: And there you have it, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>─all wrapped up like a Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide gift basket.
490.translation_description: Ed ecco fatto, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>: tutto pronto, come un cesto-<hex:021F0103>regalo della Festa delle Uova.

492.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE2
492.description: Ye know I'm in the middle o' yer venture, don't ye?
492.translation_description: Sai che sono ancora nel bel mezzo della tua spedizione, vero?

495.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE5
495.description: I trust there is a reason for this interruption?
495.translation_description: Spero che ci sia un motivo per questa interruzione.

496.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE6
496.description: I came as quickly as I could! What is it?
496.translation_description: Sono arrivato il prima possibile! Che succede?

500.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
500.description: You couldn't have picked a more inconvenient time.

501.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
501.description: This better be worth my time.

504.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
504.description: Tell me you ain't got somethin' else for me, chief!
504.translation_description: Dimmi che non c'è altro da fare per me, capo!

505.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE3
505.description: You have interrupted my venture. Proceed.
505.translation_description: Hai interrotto la mia spedizione. Dimmi.

509.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
509.translation_description: Hai un altro compito per me, <hex:02081DE905FF0C4D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C4D696F207369676E6F726503>?

510.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
510.description: I'm a little busy, but what is it?
510.translation_description: Ho un po' da fare, ma dimmi.

512.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
512.translation_description: Mi hai chiamato? <hex:021A020203>Adesso<hex:021A020103>? Va bene, se insisti.

513.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
513.description: You do know how this works, right? You assign me a venture and then leave me to my task.
513.translation_description: Sai come funziona, vero? Mi assegni una spedizione e poi mi lasci lavorare.

515.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
515.description: Hail to thee, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Your humble servant has set aside his task and hastened to your side.
515.translation_description: Salute a te, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>. Il tuo umile servitore ha messo da parte il compito per raggiungerti.

516.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
516.description: Why'd ye call me back from me venture, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>?
516.translation_description: Perché mi hai richiamato dalla spedizione, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>?

517.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE3
517.description: This really isn't the best time.
517.translation_description: Non è proprio il momento migliore.

518.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
518.description: I thought you were going to let me do this my way?
518.translation_description: Pensavo che mi avresti lasciato fare a modo mio.

523.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
523.description: What's all this, then? Another chance for mischief?
523.translation_description: Che succede? Un'altra occasione per combinare guai?

524.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
524.description: <yawn> Just so you know, I was busy carrying out your tasks.
524.translation_description: <sbadiglia> Giusto perché tu lo sappia, stavo portando a termine i tuoi incarichi.

528.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE2
528.description: <hex:02080EE905FF054D697373FF0453697203>, you mustn't interrupt a soldier when he's on a mission!
528.translation_description: <hex:020817E905FF0A5369676E6F72696E61FF085369676E6F726503>, non si interrompe un soldato durante una missione!

530.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
530.description: You would burden me with additional tasks?

531.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
531.description: I thought I asked you to leave me to my task?
531.translation_description: Non ti avevo chiesto di lasciarmi lavorare?

533.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE1
533.description: Forgive me, <hex:020811E905FF066D6164616DFF06736972727203>, but your catcall comes at an inopportune time.
533.translation_description: Perdonami, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>, ma mi hai chiamato in un momento poco opportuno.

534.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
534.description: Damn, just when I was startin' to enjoy meself!
534.translation_description: Accidenti, proprio quando cominciavo a divertirmi!

535.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
535.description: A cat must be allowed to focus on her task.
535.translation_description: Una gatta deve potersi concentrare sul proprio compito.

536.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
536.description: You know I've not finished the venture yet, rrright?
536.translation_description: Sai che la spedizione non è ancora finita, vero?

537.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE5
537.description: Mind explainin' what this is about?

538.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
538.description: You know, you shouldn't summon me when I'm in the middle of a venture!
538.translation_description: Sai che non dovresti chiamarmi mentre sono in spedizione!

541.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE3
541.description: I've returned. What is it now?
541.translation_description: Sono tornato. E adesso che c'è?

542.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
542.description: Yeah? I was just enjoyin' a pint of─hic─uh, venturin'.
542.translation_description: Sì? Stavo giusto gustando una pinta di... hic... ehm, spedizioni.

543.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
543.description: I've already got my hands full with this venture, but what is it?
543.translation_description: Sono già impegnato con questa spedizione, ma dimmi.

545.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE1
545.description: I am at <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>'s beck and call.

549.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
549.description: I do not take kindly to interruptions.

550.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
550.description: Dammit, <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>, did ye forget I was out on a venture?
550.translation_description: Maledizione, <hex:020815E905FF08726167617A7A61FF08726167617A7A6F03>, ti ricordi che sono in spedizione?

553.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
553.description: I have a life outside of <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, you know.
553.translation_description: Ho una vita anche al di fuori di <hex:021A020203>te<hex:021A020103>, sai.

554.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
554.description: Let me tell you, it was absolute chaos out there. Quite frankly, I'm lucky to be alive! But I heard your call, and I knew I had to answer.
554.translation_description: Là fuori è stato il caos più totale. A dire il vero, è un miracolo che sia ancora vivo! Ma ho sentito la tua chiamata e sapevo che dovevo rispondere.

555.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
555.description: Worried about your venture? Don't be. Or have you some other reason for summoning me?
555.translation_description: Ti preoccupa la spedizione? Non devi. O mi hai chiamato per un altro motivo?

556.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
556.description: Fair moon, to thee I sing,♪<hex:02100103>Bright regent of the heavens,♪<hex:02100103>Say, why is everything♪<hex:02100103>Either at sixes or at sevens?♪
556.translation_description: Luna splendente, a te canto,♪<hex:02100103>Chiara sovrana dei cieli,♪<hex:02100103>Dimmi, perché va tutto♪<hex:02100103>A rotoli o a soqquadro?♪

557.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
557.description: <hex:020815E905FF084D79206C616479FF084D79206C6F726403>. Is there aught else you require?

558.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE2
558.description: Can't say I was expecting this. What can I do for you?
558.translation_description: Non me l'aspettavo. Come posso aiutarti?

560.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
560.description: Now, before you go jumping to conclusions, I'd just like to─ Oh! What can I do for you?
560.translation_description: Prima che tu tragga conclusioni, volevo solo... Oh! Come posso aiutarti?

561.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
561.description: I-It's not like I was slaving away to make you happy or anything.
561.translation_description: N-Non è che abbia fatto i salti mortali per renderti felice, o qualcosa del genere.

562.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
562.description: Somethin' else I can do for you, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>? Don't hold back now.
562.translation_description: Ti serve altro, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>? Non farti problemi, chiedi pure.

563.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE1
563.description: If there is something else you would have me do, you need only say the word.
563.translation_description: Se vuoi che faccia qualcos'altro, basta che tu me lo dica.

564.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE2
564.description: I am here. I don't have to be happy about it.
564.translation_description: Eccomi. Non è che debba esserne felice.

566.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE4
566.description: Phew! Glad you got me out of <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103>─er, never mind. What can I do you for?
566.translation_description: Meno male che mi hai tirato fuori da <hex:021A020203>quella situazione<hex:021A020103>... Ehm, lascia stare. Che cosa posso fare per te?

567.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE5
567.description: Gahahaha! Couldn't wait to see you, myself!
567.translation_description: Ahahah! Non vedevo l'ora di rivederti!

568.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE6
568.description: Well, that was awfully sudden! You truly cannot get enough of me, can you?
568.translation_description: Che sorpresa! Non ti stanchi mai di me, vero?

569.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE1
569.description: Need something taken care of immediately? You have only to say the word!
569.translation_description: Ti serve che mi occupi subito di qualcosa? Basta che tu me lo chieda!

570.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE2
570.description: Some kind of emergency, eh? No problem─I work even better under pressure.
570.translation_description: È un'emergenza, eh? Nessun problema: sotto pressione rendo ancora meglio.

572.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE4
572.description: My, my, aren't we in a rush? I barely had time to get started.
572.translation_description: Ma come siamo impazienti! Non ho fatto neanche in tempo a cominciare.

573.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE5
573.description: What? What's so damn important!? You're lucky you're on my good side...
573.translation_description: Cosa? Che cosa può essere così urgente!? Meno male che non ce l'ho con te...

574.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE6
574.description: Yes, yes, here I am again! Whatever could it be?
574.translation_description: Sì, sì, eccomi di nuovo! Che cosa può essere?

575.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE1
575.description: I was hoping you would call, love.
575.translation_description: Speravo proprio che mi chiamassi, amore.

576.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE2
576.description: What is the matter? Why do you summon me back so soon!?
576.translation_description: Che succede? Perché mi richiami così presto!?

577.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE3
577.description: I trust there is a good reason for this interruption?
577.translation_description: Spero ci sia una buona ragione per questa interruzione.

578.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE4
578.description: <yawn> You do know I was in the middle of something...yes?
578.translation_description: <sbadiglia> Lo sai che ero nel bel mezzo di una faccenda, vero?

579.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE5
579.description: What is it this time? I was just beginning to have some fun...
579.translation_description: E adesso cosa c'è? Stavo appena cominciando a divertirmi...

580.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE6
580.description: You frightened me, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>! Is something the matter!?
580.translation_description: Mi hai fatto prendere un colpo, <hex:020815E905FF085369676E6F7261FF085369676E6F726503>! È successo qualcosa!?

581.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_VIERA_MALE_TYPE1
581.description: I rushed back as soon as I heard your call. You have need of my services?
581.translation_description: Sono tornato subito appena ho sentito la tua chiamata. Hai bisogno dei miei servizi?

582.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_VIERA_MALE_TYPE2
582.description: I'm a bit sodding busy, yer <hex:020817E905FF096C61647973686970FF096C6F72647368697003>. Ye get mud on yer shiny boots, or summat?
582.translation_description: Sono dannatamente impegnato, <hex:020825E905FF10566F73747261205369676E6F726961FF10566F73747261205369676E6F72696103>. Ha infangato gli stivali lucidi, o che?

584.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_VIERA_MALE_TYPE4
584.description: What is it? What's wrong? ...Aside from me missing my favorite barstool?
584.translation_description: Che succede? Qualcosa non va? ...A parte il fatto che mi manca il mio sgabello preferito?

585.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_VIERA_MALE_TYPE5
585.description: Yes? This is interfering with <hex:021A020203>your<hex:021A020103> venture, just so you know.
585.translation_description: Sappi che questo sta interferendo con <hex:021A020203>la tua<hex:021A020103> spedizione.

586.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER2_VIERA_MALE_TYPE6
586.description: Is something amiss? Or did you simply miss <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>?
586.translation_description: C'è qualcosa che non va? O ti <hex:021A020203>mancavo<hex:021A020103> soltanto?

587.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE1
587.description: I shall return to my duties forthwith.

596.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE4
596.description: Guess I'll get back to that venture you assigned me.
596.translation_description: Direi che torno alla spedizione che mi hai assegnato.

597.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
597.description: That was not worth my time.

598.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
598.description: I'll take care of it, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, don't you worry!
598.translation_description: Me ne occupo io, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>, non preoccuparti!

600.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE2
600.description: Don't forget that I'm busy with this venture o' yours, chief!
600.translation_description: Non dimenticare che sono ancora impegnato in questa tua spedizione, capo!

604.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE6
604.description: Understood, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>! Oh, and fear not─the venture shall be completed on time!
604.translation_description: Ricevuto, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>! E non temere: la spedizione sarà completata in tempo!

605.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE1
605.description: I shall carry out <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>'s wishes to the best of my ability.
605.translation_description: Eseguirò i tuoi ordini al meglio, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>.

606.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
606.description: We finished? That venture's not goin' to finish itself.
606.translation_description: Abbiamo finito? La spedizione non si completerà da sola.

608.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
608.description: If you would excuse me, I have a venture to finish.
608.translation_description: Con permesso, devo portare a termine una spedizione.

609.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
609.description: Unless it is urgent, do not summon me during a venture again.
609.translation_description: Se non è urgente, non richiamarmi durante una spedizione.

611.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
611.description: Do not hesitate to call on me again, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.
611.translation_description: Non esitare a chiamarmi di nuovo, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

614.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
614.description: I can't keep runnin' back to see you during these ventures, you know.
614.translation_description: Non posso correre sempre da te mentre sono in spedizione, sai.

618.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
618.description: So much to do, so little time!
618.translation_description: Tante cose da fare, così poco tempo!

619.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
619.description: We'd best see to our respective tasks, eh?
619.translation_description: Meglio che ci occupiamo dei nostri rispettivi compiti, eh?

620.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
620.description: Don't summon me, I'll summon you.

621.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE5
621.description: <sigh> I am not getting paid enough for this.
621.translation_description: <sospira> Non mi pagano abbastanza per questo.

623.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE1
623.description: If there is naught else, I will rrresume my venture.
623.translation_description: Se non c'è altro, torno alla mia spedizione.

626.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
626.description: I suppose you want me to finish the venture too, don't you? <sigh>
626.translation_description: Immagino che tu voglia anche che finisca la spedizione, vero? <sospira>

627.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
627.description: Pray do not disturb me until the venture is complete.
627.translation_description: Ti prego, non disturbarmi finché la spedizione non sarà terminata.

628.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
628.description: Patience, my good <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>. Your venture will be finished in due time.
628.translation_description: Un po' di pazienza, <hex:02080FE905FF0563617261FF056361726F03>. La spedizione sarà completata a tempo debito.

629.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE1
629.description: I shall rrreturn to my venture, <hex:020811E905FF066D6164616DFF06736972727203>.

632.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
632.description: I told you I'd take care of it, so stop worrying.
632.translation_description: Te l'avevo detto: ci avrei pensato io. Smettila di preoccuparti.

634.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
634.description: ...Try as I might, I can't stay mad at you.
634.translation_description: Per quanto ci provi, non riesco a prendermela con te a lungo.

635.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
635.description: Beg your pardon, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, but I must needs return to my venture.
635.translation_description: Scusami, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>, ma devo tornare alla mia spedizione.

638.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
638.description: Now then, if ye'll─hic─excuse me, I've got a venture what needs doin'!
638.translation_description: Allora, con permesso... hic... ho una spedizione da portare a termine!

639.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
639.description: All right. Let me handle it.
639.translation_description: Va bene. Lascia fare a me.

640.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
640.description: Happy to be of service, chief!

642.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE2
642.description: Ye still want me to carry out that venture, too, eh? Just checkin'.
642.translation_description: Vuoi che porti a termine anche quella spedizione, vero? Chiedevo soltanto.

644.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
644.description: 'Fore you ask, I've not forgotten about the venture.
644.translation_description: Prima che tu lo chieda, non mi sono dimenticato della spedizione.

645.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
645.description: If you want quality work, then leave me be.
645.translation_description: Se vuoi un lavoro fatto bene, lasciami lavorare in pace.

647.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
647.description: Then if you would excuse me, I should return to my venture.
647.translation_description: Con permesso, dovrei tornare alla mia spedizione.

648.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
648.description: Right, then. I ought to be getting back to that thing of yours. “Venture,” was it...?
648.translation_description: Bene, torno a occuparmi di quella cosa che mi hai chiesto. Com'era? «Spedizione»...?

649.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
649.description: We shall meet again, old friend. But now I must steal away into the night.
649.translation_description: Ci rivedremo, vecchio compagno. Ma ora devo dileguarmi nella notte.

650.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
650.description: If I don't make it back, I just want you to know... Eh, the hells with it. I'll tell you next time.
650.translation_description: Se non dovessi tornare, vorrei dirti che... Al diavolo, te lo racconterò la prossima volta.

652.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
652.description: I must wander to and fro;♪<hex:02100103>But wherever I may go,♪<hex:02100103>I shall never be untrue to thee!♪
652.translation_description: Devo vagare qua e là;♪<hex:02100103>Ma ovunque mi porterà la via,♪<hex:02100103>Ti resterò sempre fedele!♪

654.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE2
654.description: I suppose you'll be wanting me to finish that venture too, yes? Right, right. Don't know why I bothered asking...
654.translation_description: Immagino che vorrai anche che finisca quella spedizione, vero? Sì, sì. Non so perché mi sia preso la briga di chiedertelo...

656.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
656.description: Right, so, if anyone asks, I wasn't here, agreed? Cheers.
656.translation_description: Se qualcuno chiede, io non sono mai passato, d'accordo? Grazie!

657.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
657.description: Go on, then. Go. It's not like I haven't more important things to do or anything.
657.translation_description: Vai pure, allora. Vai. Tanto non è che abbia cose più importanti da fare.

658.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
658.description: Hm, hm. You've really nothin' else to ask? If you say so, then.
658.translation_description: Mh, mh. Non hai proprio nient'altro da chiedermi? Se lo dici tu...

659.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE1
659.description: I am ever at your beck and call, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.

660.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE2
660.description: Don't expect me to play errand boy for you forever.
660.translation_description: Non aspettarti che faccia da fattorino per sempre.

662.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE4
662.description: If there's nothing else, I'll be getting back to...er, what was it again? Oh, yes, the venture!
662.translation_description: Se non c'è altro, torno a... com'era? Ah sì, alla spedizione!

663.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE5
663.description: Gahahaha! Back to work for me!

664.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE6
664.description: Are you sure you don't want to spend more time with me? Ah, but I jest!
664.translation_description: Non ti va di passare altro tempo con me? Ah, ma sto scherzando!

665.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE1
665.description: I'll be on my way, then. Pray keep an eye out for my return!
665.translation_description: Allora vado. Aspetta il mio ritorno!

666.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE2
666.description: All good? I'll get right to it, then.
666.translation_description: Tutto a posto? Allora mi metto subito al lavoro.

667.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE3
667.description: I'll be on my way, then. I still have work to do...
667.translation_description: Allora vado. Ho ancora del lavoro da fare...

668.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE4
668.description: I'll return to my leisurely stroll, then. ...Sorry, I mean “grand adventure.”
668.translation_description: Torno alla mia passeggiata tranquilla... Scusa, volevo dire alla mia «grande avventura».

669.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE5
669.description: Are you <hex:021A020203>sure<hex:021A020103> I'm free to go this time? ...You're positive? Alright, then.
669.translation_description: Confermi che stavolta posso andare? ...Hai <hex:021A020203>la certezza<hex:021A020103>? Va bene, allora.

670.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE6
670.description: I'll be getting back to the job, then!

671.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE1
671.description: If ever you're feeling lonely, I am but a ring of the bell away.
671.translation_description: Se ti manca un po' di compagnia, ti basta suonare la campana per trovarmi.

672.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE2
672.description: I am off! At least until you call me back again...
672.translation_description: Vado! Almeno finché non mi richiamerai...

673.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE3
673.translation_description: La strada mi chiama di nuovo.

674.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE4
674.description: <yawn> I really could use a nap...
674.translation_description: <sbadiglia> Mi farebbe proprio comodo un pisolino...

675.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE5
675.description: Well, back to the grind! I do hope you appreciate all this!
675.translation_description: Bene, torno alla routine! Spero tu apprezzi tutto questo!

676.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE6
676.description: If that is all, I shall return to my task. Ah, the joy of adventure!
676.translation_description: Se è tutto, torno al mio incarico. Ah, il piacere dell'avventura!

677.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_MALE_TYPE1
677.description: Are you certain? If needs be, I can return at a moment's notice!
677.translation_description: Sei proprio sicuro? Se serve, posso tornare in un attimo!

678.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_MALE_TYPE2
678.description: If that'll be all, I'll get back to that other thing ye asked me to do.
678.translation_description: Se è tutto, torno all'altro incarico che mi hai affidato.

679.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_MALE_TYPE3
679.description: If you've no further need of me, I shall return to my assigned task.
679.translation_description: Se non hai più bisogno di me, tornerò all'incarico che mi è stato assegnato.

680.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_MALE_TYPE4
680.description: I'll head back out, then. Duty first, debauchery second!
680.translation_description: Allora torno in viaggio. Prima il dovere, poi i bagordi!

681.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_MALE_TYPE5
681.description: Hmph. You're sure that's everything? I'd rather not be running back and forth, if it's all the same to you.
681.translation_description: Umpf. È tutto? Preferirei non dover fare avanti e indietro, se possibile.

682.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_VIERA_MALE_TYPE6
682.description: I really must be on the road again. Pray no harm befalls my soft, furry hide!
682.translation_description: Devo rimettermi in viaggio. Che la mia morbida pelliccia resti al sicuro!

683.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE1
683.description: It pleases me to inform you that the venture is complete.
683.translation_description: Ti comunico con piacere che la spedizione è completa.

684.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HYURAN_MALE_TYPE2
684.description: Hey, I finished that venture o' yours.
684.translation_description: Ehi, ho finito la tua spedizione.

689.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE1
689.description: My <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>, the venture you bid me undertake has been finished.
689.translation_description: Ho portato a termine la spedizione che mi hai affidato, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>.

690.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE2
690.description: I've got your goods, by the way. Let me know when you want 'em.
690.translation_description: Ho qui i tuoi oggetti. Dimmi quando li vuoi.

693.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE5
693.translation_description: Il rapporto della spedizione è pronto.

694.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HYURAN_FEMALE_TYPE6
694.description: Good news, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>! The venture was a success!
694.translation_description: Buone notizie, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>! La spedizione è stata un successo!

697.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE3
697.description: I have come with your goods.

698.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE4
698.description: I took care of that venture for you.
698.translation_description: Ho completato la spedizione per te.

699.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ELEZEN_MALE_TYPE5
699.description: You wish to hear my report?

702.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE2
702.description: This about the venture? I took care of it.
702.translation_description: È per la spedizione? È tutto fatto.

703.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE3
703.description: There you are! I've brought what you requested.
703.translation_description: Eccoti! Ti ho portato ciò che avevi chiesto.

704.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE4
704.description: Oh, it's you. I suppose you'll want to hear about the venture.
704.translation_description: Ah, sei tu. Immagino che vorrai sapere com'è andata la spedizione.

705.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE5
705.description: Let's get on with it, shall we?

706.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ELEZEN_FEMALE_TYPE6
706.description: I've been waiting for your summons.

707.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE1
707.description: Hail to thee, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. You shall be pleased to hear that the venture was a success.
707.translation_description: Salute a te, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>. La spedizione è stata un successo.

708.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE2
708.description: You want this stuff now or later?
708.translation_description: Vuoi questa roba adesso o dopo?

710.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE4
710.description: Been a long time comin', but the venture's finally finished.
710.translation_description: Ci è voluto un po', ma la spedizione è finalmente conclusa.

712.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_LALAFELL_MALE_TYPE6
712.description: I did it, I did it!
712.translation_description: Ci sono riuscito, ci sono riuscito!

713.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE1
713.description: Does <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> wish to hear my report?

714.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE2
714.description: 'Ello, dearie. I reckon you want your goods?
714.translation_description: Salve, tesoro. Immagino tu voglia i tuoi oggetti?

715.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE3
715.description: My pockets are bursting with your goods!
715.translation_description: Ho le tasche piene dei tuoi oggetti!

716.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE4
716.description: Well, this was to be expected. The venture, yes?
716.translation_description: Era prevedibile. Sei qui per la spedizione, vero?

717.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_LALAFELL_FEMALE_TYPE5
717.description: We should talk about the venture.

722.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE4
722.description: May I leave after making my report? No? <sigh>
722.translation_description: Posso andare dopo averti fatto rapporto? No? <sospira>

723.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE5
723.description: I have prepared a formal report.

724.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_MIQOTE_MALE_TYPE6
724.description: Am I to deliver my report now, or shall we discuss other matters first?
724.translation_description: Devo fare rapporto adesso o preferisci parlare prima di altro?

725.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE1
725.description: This cat has brought you a present, <hex:020811E905FF066D6164616DFF06736972727203>...
725.translation_description: Questa gatta ti ha portato un dono, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>...

726.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE2
726.description: Ye want to hear the whole story, or just read the report?
726.translation_description: Vuoi sentire tutta la storia o ti basta leggere il rapporto?

727.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE3
727.description: 'Twas naught more than a rrroutine task.
727.translation_description: Non era che un incarico di routine.

728.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE4
728.description: I did my very best, just like I said.
728.translation_description: Ho fatto del mio meglio, proprio come promesso.

729.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE5
729.description: Everythin' you need to know is in the report.
729.translation_description: Nel rapporto trovi tutto quello che c'è da sapere.

730.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_MIQOTE_FEMALE_TYPE6
730.description: I have so much to tell you!
730.translation_description: Ho un sacco di cose da raccontarti!

731.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE1
731.description: I have brought that which you desire, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

732.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE2
732.description: Bwahahaha! That venture was an <hex:021A020203>ad<hex:021A020103>venture, let me tell ye!
732.translation_description: Ahahah! Quella spedizione è stata un'<hex:021A020203>avventura<hex:021A020103> in piena regola, te lo dico!

734.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE4
734.description: Venture? What in the seven hells are ye─ Oh, the <hex:021A020203>venture<hex:021A020103>! Aye, I did that.
734.translation_description: Una spedizione? Ma che diamine stai... Oh, la <hex:021A020203>spedizione<hex:021A020103>! Sì, me ne sono occupato.

735.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE5
735.description: Got a delivery for you. Just say the word.
735.translation_description: Ho una consegna per te. Basta che tu me lo dica.

736.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_MALE_TYPE6
736.description: Hey, chief! I got what ye asked for!
736.translation_description: Ehi, capo! Ho quello che mi hai chiesto!

737.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE1
737.description: I have what <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403> requested in my possession.
737.translation_description: Ho con me ciò che mi hai chiesto, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>.

740.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE4
740.description: Took a while, but the venture's done.
740.translation_description: Ci è voluto un po', ma la spedizione è finita.

741.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE5
741.description: I had a mind to summon <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, actually.

742.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_ROEGADYN_FEMALE_TYPE6
742.description: This venturin' business ain't so bad!
742.translation_description: Questo lavoro di spedizioni non è poi così male!

743.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE1
743.description: It pleases me to inform you that the venture is complete.
743.translation_description: Ti comunico con piacere che la spedizione è terminata.

744.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE2
744.description: Guess what I've got for you! No, really. Guess!
744.translation_description: Indovina cosa ti ho portato! Dai, prova a indovinare!

745.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE3
745.description: I renew my objection to that pointless endeavor. Informally now and by affidavit later.
745.translation_description: Ribadisco la mia contrarietà a quell'inutile impresa. Per ora a voce, poi la metterò per iscritto con una dichiarazione giurata.

746.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE4
746.description: You know, I think I'm starting to get the hang of this.
746.translation_description: Sai, comincio a prenderci la mano.

747.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE5
747.description: Per your orders, I have completed the venture...<hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>.
747.translation_description: Come da tuoi ordini, ho completato la spedizione...<hex:020815E905FF085369676E6F7261FF085369676E6F726503>.

748.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_AURA_MALE_TYPE6
748.description: For he himself has said it,♪<hex:02100103>And it's greatly to his credit,♪<hex:02100103>That he is a retainer!♪<hex:02100103>He remains a retainer!♪
748.translation_description: Lui stesso l'ha detto,♪<hex:02100103>E questo gli fa onore,♪<hex:02100103>Che è un servitore!♪<hex:02100103>Resta un servitore!♪

749.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE1
749.description: I have seen to the venture, <hex:020815E905FF086D79206C616479FF086D79206C6F726403>.

750.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE2
750.description: Oh, the tales I could tell you about that venture...
750.translation_description: Avrei tante storie da raccontarti su quella spedizione...

752.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE4
752.description: Heh, didn't expect him to put up such a─ Oh! Just the <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> I was hoping to see!
752.translation_description: Ah, non pensavo che reggesse così... Oh! Proprio la <hex:020815E905FF08706572736F6E61FF08706572736F6E6103> che speravo di vedere!

753.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE5
753.description: I-It's not like I risked life and limb to bring you back shiny baubles or anything.
753.translation_description: N-Non è che abbia rischiato la vita e l'incolumità per riportarti gioielli luccicanti, o qualcosa del genere!

754.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_AURA_FEMALE_TYPE6
754.description: Oh, it has been a day such as you wouldn't believe!
754.translation_description: Non puoi immaginare che giornata sia stata!

755.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE1
755.description: Rest assured that I spared no effort in doing your bidding, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>.
755.translation_description: Ti assicuro che non ho risparmiato alcuno sforzo per esaudire i tuoi ordini, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>.

756.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE2
756.description: This is all you will get from me. I hope it satisfies you.
756.translation_description: Questo è tutto ciò che otterrai da me. Spero ti basti.

758.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE4
758.description: I'm back! Now, do you want the good news or the bad news?
758.translation_description: Sono tornato! Vuoi la buona o la cattiva notizia?

759.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE5
759.description: Gahahaha! Feast your eyes on this!

760.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HROTHGAR_MALE_TYPE6
760.description: Guess who's returned with a tale to tell? Why, <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>, of course!
760.translation_description: Indovina chi è tornato con una storia da raccontare? Proprio <hex:021A020203>io<hex:021A020103>, ovviamente!

761.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE1
761.description: I am returned! And with a souvenir for you, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>!

762.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE2
762.description: Done! No need to thank me!
762.translation_description: Fatto! Non c'è bisogno di ringraziarmi!

763.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE3
763.translation_description: Il mio viaggio è stato... fruttuoso.

764.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE4
764.description: I followed your scent all the way home. Did you miss me, <hex:020813E905FF076D696C616479FF076D696C6F726403>?
764.translation_description: Ho seguito il tuo odore fin qui. Ti sono mancata, <hex:02081DE905FF0C6D6961207369676E6F7261FF0C6D696F207369676E6F726503>?

765.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE5
765.description: Phew...I'm back! Just wait till you see what I've brought...
765.translation_description: Uff... eccomi! Aspetta di vedere cosa ti ho portato...

766.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_HROTHGAR_FEMALE_TYPE6
766.description: Here I am, back from the trail! Returned in triumph!
766.translation_description: Eccomi, di ritorno dalla spedizione! Trionfo!

767.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE1
767.description: I have returned, love. And do I have a tale to tell...
767.translation_description: Eccomi, amore. E ho tante storie da raccontare...

768.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE2
768.description: Hah! Now <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> was a venture for the ages!
768.translation_description: Ah! Questa è stata una spedizione <hex:021A020203>memorabile<hex:021A020103>!

769.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE3
769.description: There are places I would rather be, yet here I am. Be grateful.
769.translation_description: Ci sono altri posti in cui preferirei stare, e invece sono qui. Apprezzalo.

770.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE4
770.description: <yawn> Oh...that's right. I had something to tell you.
770.translation_description: <sbadiglia> Oh... già. Dovevo dirti una cosa.

771.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE5
771.description: I've returned! Come now, are you not happy to see me?
771.translation_description: Eccomi! Su, non sei felice di vedermi?

772.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_FEMALE_TYPE6
772.description: I could scarcely wait to return to your side, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203>!
772.translation_description: Non vedevo l'ora di tornare da te, <hex:020815E905FF085369676E6F7261FF085369676E6F726503>!

773.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_MALE_TYPE1
773.description: I am returned! And I have come bearing a gift.
773.translation_description: Eccomi di ritorno, con un regalo per te.

774.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_MALE_TYPE2
774.description: About damn time! My ears were twitching summat fierce listening out for that bell...
774.translation_description: Era ora! Mi si sono rizzati gli orecchi a forza di aspettare il suono della campana...

775.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_MALE_TYPE3
775.description: I believe this concludes your venture, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>...
775.translation_description: Direi che la spedizione è conclusa, <hex:020815E905FF087369676E6F7261FF087369676E6F726503>...

776.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_MALE_TYPE4
776.description: I have returned, and gods have I worked up a thirst! Oh, and this is for you!
776.translation_description: Sono tornato, e che sete! Oh, questo è per te!

777.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_MALE_TYPE5
777.description: I did what you asked. You'll be wanting my full report, then?
777.translation_description: Ho fatto quello che mi hai chiesto. Vuoi sentire tutto il rapporto?

778.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER3_VIERA_MALE_TYPE6
778.description: Wait until you see the goods I got my paws on!
778.translation_description: Aspetta di vedere cosa ho scovato con le mie zampe!

779.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ENTER_PIXIE_1
779.description: Oh, my adorable sapling! You have need of <hex:022903EA0203>, yes? But sing the word, and let your beautiful branch do what only they can.
779.translation_description: Oh, mio adorabile virgulto! Hai bisogno di <hex:022903EA0203>, vero? Basta che tu lo dica e il tuo bel ramo farà ciò che sa fare meglio.

780.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_ACCEPT_PIXIE_1
780.description: A whispered word, and off goes <hex:022903EA0203> on a grand adventure! What wonders await at journey's end?
780.translation_description: Basta un sussurro e <hex:022903EA0203> parte per una grande avventura! Chissà quali meraviglie lo attendono alla fine del viaggio?

781.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_COMPLETE_PIXIE_1
781.description: Carried by the wind, the leaf flutters to the ground─and so does <hex:022903EA0203> return to your side. Was the journey a fruitful one?
781.translation_description: La foglia, trasportata dal vento, volteggia fino a terra; così <hex:022903EA0203> fa ritorno al tuo fianco. Il viaggio ha dato buoni frutti?

782.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE_PIXIE_1
782.description: You have no more need of <hex:022903EA0203>? So be it! I shall steal quietly from your loyal servant's dreams.
782.translation_description: Non hai più bisogno di <hex:022903EA0203>? E sia! Scivolerò in silenzio via dai sogni del tuo servitore devoto.

783.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_LEAVE2_PIXIE_1
783.description: Very well. I shall slip quietly from <hex:022903EA0203>'s dreams. May your leaf flutter, float, and find a way back to you.
783.translation_description: Va bene. Scivolerò in silenzio via dai sogni di <hex:022903EA0203>. Che la tua foglia voli, fluttui e ritrovi la strada per tornare da te.

784.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRETAINERBELL_00544_EQUIP_PIXIE_1
784.description: From verdant green to glittering gold, so does the leaf take on delightful hues with each new season. If you would see <hex:022903EA0203> dressed in new colors, your beautiful branch will attend to the task.
784.translation_description: Dal verde rigoglioso all'oro scintillante, la foglia si tinge di sfumature incantevoli a ogni cambio di stagione. Se vuoi vedere <hex:022903EA0203> con nuovi colori, il tuo bel ramo se ne occuperà.
